interruption.observation: Returned screenshot and visible HUD unexpectedly show opening guard, RECOVER MARA SOLBERG, 00:00, health 100, shield 60, ammo 30/180 and no recovered memories. No terminal screen or terminal stats captured.
interruption.cause: Unknown. A terminal transition and accidental UI activation during the live action is possible but unverified. No outcome inferred.

attempts.note: Unexpected opening state was captured after sequence 41. No deliberate visible START FRESH selection after a preserved terminal result occurred. No additional adaptive gameplay followed; cannot certify whether this reset constituted another attempt.

between_attempt_learning: No valid between-attempt boundary reached. During attempt 1, learned to reopen map for orientation, release MOVE and hold APPROACH near receivers, and step back to see and target a coil. No second-attempt improvement assessed.
blocker: Unobserved transition/reset across a live resume-and-input action destroyed the ability to preserve an actual first terminal outcome before any fresh start. Continuing would not satisfy exactly two verified fresh terminal attempts with the required reporting gate. Stopped without inferring win/loss or starting another run.

scores.scale: 0 unusable, 5 mixed with substantial friction, 10 exceptional observed mobile experience; outcome alone is not a quality grade.
scores.reason_withheld: Requested holistic scores only after both attempts. Neither terminal outcome was verified; no final score or rescore fabricated. Observations above cover only assessed content.
